items.summary: Reposition the studio page away from solo-origin proof and toward a professional creative studio presence with a stronger operating model, portfolio framing, and collaboration posture.
items.why: The founder direction is clear: as project sites become more refined and immersive, the brand anchor must stop reading like a one-person bet and start reading like the studio behind a serious portfolio.
items.recipe: Rewrite studio/index.html metadata, origin copy, operating section, FAQ, collaboration CTA, and timeline blurbs; add a public content-posture gate that flags solo-bet framing on public HTML.

items.summary: Prove the S167 signed-in member persistence fix with a real browser seed instead of relying on static inspection.
items.why: The founder-reported bug was experiential: signed-in members refreshed or navigated and still saw anonymous membership prompts. The fix needs browser evidence that persisted Supabase storage stamps account truth before lazy account UI hydrates.
items.recipe: Add a focused Playwright spec that seeds the Supabase localStorage session shape, verifies body/html data-vs-signed-in after reload/navigation, confirms account-chip.js lazy-loads, and confirms signed-out storage renders anonymous state.

items.summary: Add a deterministic build gate for the signed-in session contract so future ambient-bundle edits cannot silently break account continuity.
items.why: The site now depends on an ordered relationship between signed-in-state.js, account-chip-loader.js, and the ambient bundle. A cheap static contract catches order drift, missing html/body attributes, or a lost vs:session-ready event before browser suites run.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-session-state-contract.mjs with self-test and normal modes, then wire it into npm run build:check after public contract checks.

items.summary: Turn the S167 visual-system caveat into a guard: intelligence surfaces must stay class-driven, themeable, and free of one-off inline styling.
items.why: The newest public intelligence surfaces are powerful, but they span Oracle, feedback, social, security, nervous-system, and homepage modules. A style-contract gate keeps them from drifting into hard-to-theme inline fragments while a later screenshot pass can focus on polish.
items.recipe: Create scripts/check-intelligence-style-contract.mjs covering core intelligence HTML and runtime assets, self-test it, and add it to build:check.

items.summary: Keep this sprint auditable by writing an implementation plan and execution log against a fresh S168 audit sidecar.
items.why: This repo has several recent successful audit cycles. Continuing that pattern matters because the site is public, SPARKED, and full of generated contracts where human memory is not acceptable proof.
items.recipe: Write docs/IMPLEMENT_PLAN.md from this audit, append execution results to docs/AUDIT_2026-05-27-S168.md/json, and include exact verification commands.

skipped.reason: Correctly deferred by S167 decision until Obelisk Phase 2 declares a stable session cookie/capability contract.
Feature-bearing membership/vaultsparked assets still need founder confirmation before delete or rewire.
Still data-gated until data/rum-summary.json has at least 50 field samples on /.

executionLog.summary: Implemented the S168 audit with the founder-directed professional studio presence pass added mid-run, plus signed-in browser proof and new contract gates.
notes: Rewrote /studio/ positioning from solo-origin proof toward professional studio operating model, portfolio, release standard, and collaboration posture.
Removed solo-bet phrasing from games/index.html, journal/vault-opened/index.html, and roadmap/index.html; posture gate now checks 117 public HTML files.
Signed-in browser proof passed 2/2 in Chromium against local preview.
Full build:check passed end-to-end, crawling 108 HTML files with 0 status failures and 0 blocking-script findings.
Intelligence style contract is advisory until the known inline-style debt is burned down.
